notes.title: Synthetic Hopes - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 - Hotfix

Hi everyone!

Back with a new update focused on fixing bugs and some uninteresting skips based on player feedback.

What changed:

Fixed some light hitboxes and shadows in the pools in the lab section
Fixed a skip in the lab where you could trigger the fall of a platform from below
Slowed down the boxes with cameras attached at the end of the lab. They also aim down instead of at an angle to make it fairer.
Fixed a bunch of cameras' hitboxes where you could barely slip past with a well timed jump
Added some killboxes in rotating sets to prevent the player from being stuck


Have fun!

notes.title: Synthetic Hopes - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 - Hotfix


Hello everyone!


Big thanks to everyone that started playing Synthetic Hopes.
This updates includes small fixes based on player experience and feedbacks.

What changed:

Fixed softlock in the last environment where light switches wouldn't reset after death and could lock you of picking up resources

Fixed softlock in the labyrinthic rotating set where you would get stuck in walls after respawning.

Slowed down rotating obstacles towards the end of the game to make it a bit easier

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
We updated our demo for the Steam Next Fest. Be sure to check it out!

We updated some visual and sound effects, most notably on the main action of the player: shooting clouds and platforms! We fixed some bugs and added menu options and rebindable keys.



Here are the full patchnotes:

New SFX et VFX on arm actions

Remade the big tree room

New menu tabs

New bindings menu

Localization options for the interface - added French, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese & Korean



Bug Fixes:

Fixed particles in some levels

Fixed Platform hitbox blocking player while spawning

Fixed Sounds of platforms all playing at the same time when dying



Also check out the Release Date Trailer here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zahqBt56mK4"][/dynamiclink]
